result.title: Uncertainty-Guided Reward Labeling for Reinforcement Learning under Limited Feedback
result.summary: In reinforcement learning from limited feedback (RLLF), only a small fraction of an offline dataset can be labeled with rewards, and the central question is which samples should be labeled to learn a high-performing policy from the resulting partially labeled dataset. Prior work formalized this as a reward-selection problem by focusing on the selection stage while treating downstream policy learning as a black box, in a regime where queried rewards are not retained for reward-model training. We instead study the retained-label setting, where queried rewards can be stored and used to fit a reward model before policy learning. We bound the suboptimality of the learned policy in terms of two sources of error: one arising from offline RL on a fixed, offline dataset, and the other from uncertainty in the reward model. Since reward selection cannot change the offline dataset, the limited labeling budget must be used to strategically reduce reward uncertainty. Motivated by RLLF's observation that useful rewards tend to keep the agent on high-return trajectories, we introduce Successor-Guided Uncertainty REduction (SURE), a novel method that uses successor features to select rewards that are both uncertain and associated with states from which high-valued states are reachable. We formally derive SURE from a bound-induced design objective and characterize its exact one-step marginal gain. Empirically, SURE reaches near full-feedback performance with few reward labels across a variety of domains and offline-RL backbones, yielding an effective method for feedback-efficient reinforcement learning.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究有限反馈离线强化学习中的奖励标注选择问题：在标注可保留并用于训练奖励模型的设定下，给出所学策略次优性的上界，并提出 SURE 方法，用 successor features 优先标注既不确定又处于可到达高价值状态区域的样本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「不确定性高且通往高回报状态」的预算化查询选择准则，可能为 LVR 中有限预算下挑选视觉证据或标注样本、权衡信息价值与下游收益提供概念借鉴，但与原论文的多模态推理场景对应关系仍需核查。
